text:
sec-bot: Alert: kubelet-api anomaly on node 10.10.5.8 -> multiple PATCH to /pods from pod analytics-processor-7f5d (ns: analytics). HostPath mount attempt detected. rule=kubelet-api-write severity=high

jordan: seeing same in grafana. new root process inside container PID=10432. attaching quick logs.

jordan: ```yaml
kubectl get pod analytics-processor-7f5d -n analytics -o yaml
# ... shows hostPath: /etc mounted to /etc inside container
```

lee: can we cordon that node? @oncall please take it offline.

oncall: cordoned node node-10-10-5-8 and drained non-critical pods: `kubectl cordon node-10-10-5-8 && kubectl drain node-10-10-5-8 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data -n analytics`

sanjay: grep of kubelet logs shows PATCH calls with user-agent `curl/7.64` from 172.16.9.20 (internal). suspect lateral movement.

maria: 172.16.9.20 maps to infra host-batch-02 (backup runner). @jordan can you confirm container runtime pids and mounts?

jordan: `ps aux | grep analytics-processor` -> PID 10432 owned by root. `ls -l /proc/10432/root/etc` points to host /etc. looks like namespace escape and mount propagation.

lee: isolate image and block pulls. suggest blocking image sha sha256:abcd1234 on registry and revoke node kubelet certs for node-10-10-5-8.

sanjay: registry policy updated: `deny pull` for sha256:abcd1234. rotated kubelet credentials on node-10-10-5-8.

oncall: collecting forensic artifacts: `crictl ps -a`, `crictl inspect 10432`, journalctl -u kubelet > /tmp/kubelet-node-10-10-5-8.log

sec-bot: Incident created INC-2026-143. Notified sec@redwood and paged oncall.

maria: host-batch-02 attempted AWS KMS decrypts with role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/backup-runner at 2026-03-19T10:12:05Z — check KMS and STS logs.

jordan: saw `aws sts:AssumeRole` from host-batch-02 right before the patches. timestamps match.

lee: immediate actions: 1) block host-batch-02 at FW 2) revoke backup-runner creds 3) add kubelet audit rule to reject PATCH to pod spec from non-kubelet principals 4) block registry image sha.

sanjay: opened PR restricting `patch` on pods to `system:node` & kubelet; link: https://git.redwood.dev/r/redwood/k8s-policy/pulls/42 (wip).

oncall: scheduled 1h postmortem with owners @lee and @maria tomorrow 11:00 UTC.

jordan: note for postmortem: add image-signing + pipeline check (immutable tags + cosign) and review node-level KMS role attachments.

maria: created follow-up tickets: REG-21 (registry signing), KMS-9 (key policy review), RBAC-34 (kubelet audit enforcement).

lee: great work everyone, keep updates coming here. :thumbsup:
